result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but it omits workers’ compensation insurance as required by law. The margin comment does not cure that operative omission. It also unnecessarily extends all coverages for one year after the term, which is not required by the playbook and may be unsuitable for occurrence-based CGL coverage. The original risk-of-loss allocation is otherwise preserved.
